title: Save clipboard contents to a file
summary: This command takes whatever is currently copied to your clipboard and saves it directly into a text file. It is useful for quickly saving text snippets, code, or logs without opening a text editor.

steps.explain: Redirects the output of `pbpaste` (which prints the clipboard content) into the specified file. If the file does not exist, it will be created.

placeholders.name: FILE
placeholders.description: The path to the file where you want to save the clipboard content.
